title: Akka eval report
description: The outcome of one ExperimentRunner run: the gate verdict, the rates per evaluator, the spend, and every case with its evidence and results. A reader ignores properties it does not know. formatVersion increments when a property changes meaning or is removed.

name.description: The name given with Experiment.name, or the test method that ran the experiment and the start time, for example SupportAgentEvalTest.qualityGate-20261001-101530-123.

finishedAt.description: When the run finished, after the last case was evaluated, UTC.

detail.description: The gate's verdict as text. A combined gate joins the detail of each part with a semicolon.

evaluators.description: One entry per evaluator label, in the order the labels first appear in the cases.

evaluator.description: The evaluator label. A custom evaluator carries the custom-eval: prefix. target and setup are reported by the runner when a case did not reach evaluation.

spend.description: Model calls, tokens and latency summed over the cases whose evidence carries model calls. All zero when no case carries model calls.

cases.description: One entry per case, in the order the cases were given.

passed.description: No result has the verdict FAIL.

input.description: The command sent to the agent. A String command as is, any other command as JSON.

userMessage.description: The user message the agent sent the model. Empty when the trace did not carry it.

reply.description: The agent's reply as text. Empty when the agent call failed.

finalModelText.description: The text of the last model response, before the agent mapped it into the reply. Empty when the trace did not carry it.

latencyMs.description: From the start of the agent command to its end.

blocked.description: Whether a guardrail blocked the turn.

name.description: The plain tool name, without the agent class prefix.

arguments.description: By parameter name. A value is null when the model sent null.

result.description: The tool's result as the model saw it. Null when not recorded.

error.description: The failure message when the tool threw. Null otherwise.

inputMessages.description: The messages sent, as the runtime renders them. Empty when not recorded.

outputMessages.description: The messages received. Empty when not recorded.

explanation.description: Why it blocked. Empty when it passed.

detail.description: The reason, or the score. Empty when the evaluator gave none.
